plugins.name: auto-worktree
plugins.description: Automatically creates git worktrees when Claude modifies files, enabling safe parallel work without git conflicts.

plugins.name: dispatch
plugins.description: Launch an interactive Claude Code session in another repository and auto-report its result when it finishes.

plugins.name: rimo
plugins.description: Rimo Voice integration — the rimo-cli skill plus the `rimo mcp` server. Requires the rimo CLI on your PATH.

plugins.name: loop-engineering
plugins.description: Scaffold a self-running agent loop (discover → isolate → build → verify → persist → schedule) into the current repository with /loop-engineering:init. Based on Addy Osmani's 'Loop Engineering' architecture.

plugins.name: rimo-usage
plugins.description: Tracks Claude Code rate-limit usage from the statusline and reports periodic snapshots to Rimo's OTLP collector, while keeping your existing statusline working.

plugins.name: rimo-all
plugins.description: Installs all Rimo plugins together (auto-worktree + dispatch + rimo-usage). A convenience bundle.
